subject: mathematics
instructions: Work independently. Show the mathematical steps or representation that support each response.
Check each result before submitting. A response without the requested work may require adult review.

learnerTasks.prompt: A circle is partitioned into 2 parts of equal area. What fraction of the circle does one part represent?
A shape is divided into 2 equal parts. 1 of the parts are shaded. What fraction of the shape is shaded?
A number line from 0 to 1 is divided into 4 equal lengths. What fraction names the point that is 2 lengths from 0?
A square is partitioned into 8 parts of equal area. What fraction of the square does one part represent?
A shape is divided into 6 equal parts. 4 of the parts are shaded. What fraction of the shape is shaded?
A number line from 0 to 1 is divided into 6 equal lengths. What fraction names the point that is 3 lengths from 0?
A circle is partitioned into 8 parts of equal area. What fraction of the circle does one part represent?
A shape is divided into 8 equal parts. 1 of the parts are shaded. What fraction of the shape is shaded?
A number line from 0 to 1 is divided into 8 equal lengths. What fraction names the point that is 6 lengths from 0?
A rectangle is partitioned into 6 parts of equal area. What fraction of the rectangle does one part represent?
